+# Phase24: shared runtime, selector and semantic proofs
+
+**The full serial Lean kernel check, independent actual readback, capture and
+independent capture review pass.** This continues the published
+[phase23 checkpoint](../phase23/README.md) at
+`3b5376377b0a282d225675550437f4aae8c5e7f8`. The literal 215-state machine and
+its halting/nonhalting endpoint statements are unchanged.
+
+The change combines four bounded proof cuts:
+
+- Attributed runtime cleanup shares constructor elimination, matching branches
+  and existing reachability steps in `KRuntimeCore`, `KZip` and `KBoot`.
+- Four program-parametric selector lemmas in `L2Lib254` replace repeated dispatch
+  constructions in the 254/222 roots; the seven Dom/Perm helper names remain wrappers.
+- Existing subtype and well-founded semantic transports replace repeated witness
+  bookkeeping; the private duplicate `raw_rel_iff` is removed.
+- The calculus reuses `update_comm`, `Kalmar.cases_on` and the existing top-bound
+  theorem instead of repeating local reasoning or formula induction.
+
+Claude's upstream `303ecd816c89021f29ae88084545a63bc785c893` is integrated by
+attributed `-x` cherry-pick `1b30c178dd01a20957c7260fee74cfc7c3b842bb`, retaining
+Vladimir Reshetnikov's author and Claude coauthor trailers. Its three-file physical
+reduction is 31 lines; the historical commit message's conflicting net line is
+not used for the combined measure.
+
+## Final frozen source measures
+
+| Scope | Phase23 basis | Frozen final source | Reduction |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|
+| All 13 maintained files, physical lines | 3,000 | 2,825 | 175 |
+| All 13 maintained files, source bytes | 131,004 | 122,569 | 8,435 |
+| Primary K215 endpoint, project modules | 172 | 172 | 0 |
+| Primary selected source bytes | 1,728,487 | 1,726,277 | 2,210 |
+
+The maintained measure charges the shared library, retained wrappers and six
+explicit WF annotation lines costing 298 bytes. The primary closure is a
+separate overlapping measure; the two savings must not be added. The selector
+cut alone grows the primary path by 1,509 bytes while reducing other maintained
+roots. The combined final batch reduces the primary bytes above. See the
+[source review](source-review.md) and [compatibility notes](compatibility.md).
+
+The full run checks **230 providers**: 215 project modules and fifteen unchanged
+typed clients, with **121 fresh providers / 109 exact phase23 reuses** and **two
+fresh endpoint audits**. Eleven clients, nine site batches and thirteen boot
+chunks compile fresh; all sixteen source-forward batches retain exact phase23
+bindings. The run takes **1,307.98 seconds**, an observed duration rather than
+a comparative speedup. All selected provider and audit logs have zero warnings;
+the exact 93/5/10 profiles match. The [actual readback](lean/result-review.json) checks 1,250 owner inputs,
+102 present pins and sixteen absences. It binds 218 adjacent raw provider records
+and twelve disclosed inherited absences; no record is fabricated.
+
+The [terminal result](lean/result.json) has SHA-256
+`c9bcee3023ea879ad0dcc353d1435aae8aef92963a4b79f51fda1506f518c910`.
+The deterministic [capture](lean/capture.json) passes for **640 blobs, 1,078 logical
+entries, 1,071 source aliases and 611 raw evidence files**. The archive is
+**1,828,563 bytes**, SHA-256
+`09d3ee5d9a8d7fba84e0ac0ee7c25af034a758c19f16a69d2b554542056b1ed5`.
+The [independent capture review](integration/capture-review.json) passes.
+Phase23's eleven exact external Lean leaves remain immutable; executable proof
+objects are not shipped.
+
+The first focused plan was rejected for row order before any compiler ran.
+Focused-v2 and native-diagnostic-v1 then failed at separate WF inference seams.
+Explicit subtype and raw Sat annotations complete the same proof mathematics;
+native-diagnostic-v2 passes sixteen providers, two fresh and fourteen exact
+phase23 reuses, in 2.74 seconds. No diagnostic is full endpoint acceptance or a
+reuse basis. See the [Lean evidence](lean/README.md) for receipt and runtime bindings.
+
+The separate new batch219 review of commit
+`56b37bde8b064d852154ad8478d58ec9ab5375d6` reads proposal sources and historical
+evidence only. It is outside these thirteen checked sources; this phase does not
+claim to compile or adopt its future control or scheduler leads.
+
+The literal 215-state machine and halting/nonhalting statements remain unchanged.
+The internally encoded PA endpoint, minimum-state theorem and uncompiled
+[control lead](../phase23/leads/README.md) remain outside this proof-cleanup scope.

+# Phase24 source review
+
+**The full selected kernel check, independent actual readback, capture and
+independent capture review pass.** The final table binds the repaired source
+bytes. Earlier source proposals, author reports and source-spec status labels
+retain their chronological scope; later terminal evidence establishes acceptance
+without rewriting those receipts.
+
+## Complete maintained-file comparison
+
+Positive bytes removed means a saving; the shared library growth is charged in full.
+
+| Source | Before lines | Final frozen lines | Bytes removed |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|
+| `KBoot` | 76 | 71 | +118 |
+| `KRuntimeCore` | 562 | 538 | +1,232 |
+| `KZip` | 226 | 224 | +133 |
+| `L2Lib254` | 355 | 388 | -1,723 |
+| `L2Root222` | 236 | 184 | +2,937 |
+| `L2Root254` | 236 | 183 | +2,974 |
+| `L2RootDom` | 174 | 170 | +314 |
+| `L2RootPerm` | 168 | 166 | +214 |
+| `TarskiCalculus` | 195 | 195 | +58 |
+| `TarskiClean` | 214 | 193 | +661 |
+| `TarskiDerived` | 196 | 190 | +450 |
+| `WFModelCore` | 196 | 166 | +976 |
+| `WFRelativization` | 166 | 157 | +91 |
+| **Total** | **3,000** | **2,825** | **+8,435** |
+
+The net saving is 175 physical lines / 8,435 bytes over all thirteen files.
+The primary `KEndpoint215` closure separately remains 172 modules and changes
+from 1,728,487 to 1,726,277 selected source bytes. No module or producer is retired.
+These measures overlap and must not be added. Relative to the first proposal,
+six explicit annotation lines add 298 bytes; that cost is already included.
+The earlier 181-line / 8,733-byte count remains historical, not an additional saving.
+
+## Proof mechanisms and obligations
+
+The attributed runtime patch preserves definition bodies, theorem statements
+and attributes. Constructor equality elimination replaces explicit injectivity
+bookkeeping; matching branches share proof bodies, and reachability composition
+reuses existing `run_add` facts. Machine transition data and endpoint statements
+remain exact.
+
+`L2.dec_brk`, `L2.dec_halt`, `L2.pass` and `L2.fall` generalize the existing Dom/Perm
+selector mechanism over the program while retaining its exact node equation.
+The eight 254/222 dispatch proofs use their existing program-specific bodies.
+Scratch-register and `p2` premises remain at their old callers; normal and halt
+exits stay distinct. The seven specialized names remain typed wrappers. No run
+is transferred across the different AX or fetch implementations, and root-step,
+iteration, boot and program-halting proofs remain untouched.
+
+`WFRelativization` uses constructive subtype quantifier equivalences and the
+existing `liftEnv_scons` bridge. Both WF guards remain. The final universal and
+existential branches explicitly type their subtype predicates and reflexive
+raw Sat equivalences. These annotations resolve the two rejected inference
+stages without changing the proof mathematics. `WFModelCore` reuses
+`sat_translate_scons` and `sat_translate_relOf` instead of repeating environment
+equalities and the private `raw_rel_iff` lemma. `replacementForm` and its
+specification retain both WF guards, output slot 0 / input slot 1 orientation
+and global functionality.
+
+The existing `Tarski.update_comm` header and proof move unchanged from
+`TarskiClean` into `TarskiCalculus`, where soundness reuses them. Existing import
+paths still expose the same global name. `imp_cases` reuses `Kalmar.cases_on`;
+`occurs_lt_top` follows constructively from `not_occurs_of_top_le`. All old logic
+headers and imports stay exact. No new public logic helper is added.
+
+## Evidence boundary
+
+The final source/plan readback binds all thirteen before/candidate/canonical rows,
+all 230 selected source hashes, physical sizes and actual import edges, exact DFS
+order and source-transitive freshness. It independently verifies the metrics
+above and 102 current present pins / sixteen absences. That is a binding/count
+review, not an independent mathematical review of its author's three logic edits.
+Each original source report remains an author's readback for its own files;
+mathematical review and measured full evidence keep their separate scope labels.
+
+Native-diagnostic-v2 passes sixteen providers, two fresh and fourteen exact phase23
+reuses; the two fresh WF sources match the final map and have no warnings.
+The diagnostic supplies no objects to the full run. The later full check passes
+230 providers and two endpoint audits with exact profiles and zero selected
+warnings. The [independent actual readback](lean/result-review.json) checks
+1,250 owner inputs, 102 present pins and sixteen absences, with 218 adjacent raw
+provider records and twelve inherited absences. Both capture and its
+[independent review](integration/capture-review.json) pass.
+
+Four terminal focused diagnostic contexts are retained as 240 explicit inert
+files. The first fails the metadata ordering gate before any compiler; the next
+two fail separate elaboration inferences; the final native diagnostic passes.
+None supplies full-run objects, and there is **no failed full-run prefix** this
+phase. Source reports' initial 181-line / 8,733-byte arithmetic remains historical;
+the final typed annotations and current source bindings establish 175 / 8,435.
+The [integration notes](integration/README.md) retain preparation chronology.
+
+The separate new batch219 review of commit
+`56b37bde8b064d852154ad8478d58ec9ab5375d6` reads proposal sources and historical
+evidence only. It is outside these thirteen checked sources; this phase does not
+claim to compile or adopt its future control or scheduler leads.

+# Phase24 compatibility notes
+
+**The selected compatibility, exact-profile, independent actual and capture
+checks pass.** The result concerns the fifteen maintained typed clients;
+external clients retain their own obligations.
+
+All old public declaration headers, binder names and imports are preserved.
+Definitions and machine data are unchanged. Four public selector helpers are
+added in `L2Lib254`: `L2.dec_brk`, `L2.dec_halt`, `L2.pass` and `L2.fall`.
+The existing four `L2Dom` and three `L2Perm` helpers remain at their exact old
+names and types, implemented as wrappers. The eight 254/222 dispatch endpoints
+keep their exact hypotheses and conclusions. `L2Root222` opens the new names
+locally; no export alias or wider import is added.
+
+`Tarski.update_comm` moves unchanged to the already imported calculus module;
+its namespace, statement and proof are retained. `TarskiClean` consumers still
+receive it through the old import path. The sole removed declaration is the
+private `raw_rel_iff` in `WFModelCore.lean`; its uses become applications of existing
+`sat_translate_relOf`. No old public declaration is retired or strengthened in
+this phase. Phase23's forty retirements and three stronger types remain
+historical changes and are not counted again.
+
+All fifteen accepted typed-client source hashes remain exact. Eleven clients
+compile fresh and four reuse exact phase23 bindings. All 93 client reports,
+five WFTheory reports and ten fresh endpoint-audit reports retain exact accepted
+profiles. Every source-transitively affected provider compiles fresh; all selected
+provider and audit logs have zero warnings. The
+[independent actual readback](lean/result-review.json) and
+[capture review](integration/capture-review.json) verify their respective bindings.
+
+The generic selector rules preserve decrement, zero fall-through, enclosing
+breaks and halt exits; they do not widen the existing cross-program transfer
+relation. WF Replacement retains its formula-indexed interpretation and both
+source guards. The semantic cut adds no totality premise. Existing section
+premises and exact old axiom profiles remain required validation boundaries.
+
+The literal 215-state machine, current halting/nonhalting endpoint and active
+producer stay fixed. No PA-internal endpoint, minimum-state result, object-size
+saving or comparative checking speedup follows from this source reduction.
+The new static batch219 review remains separate; its future mixed-control and
+scheduler leads are not compiled or adopted by this phase. Phase23's eleven
+Lean evidence leaves remain immutable external history.

+
+**The full serial kernel check, independent actual readback, capture and
+independent capture review pass.**

+It selects **230 providers = 215 project modules + fifteen typed clients**,
+with **121 fresh / 109 exact phase23 reuses**, eleven fresh clients and
+**two fresh endpoint audits**. It binds **102 present inputs / sixteen absences**.
+All nine site batches and thirteen boot chunks are forced fresh; the sixteen
+source-forward batches retain exact phase23 reuse bindings. The terminal
+result and independent actual reader match these bindings.
+
+The **93 client / five WFTheory / ten endpoint-audit** report profiles
+exactly match the accepted basis. All selected providers and both audits
+have zero warnings. No missing historical record is reconstructed:
+the actual reader checks **1,250 owner inputs / 102 present pins / sixteen
+absences**, with **218 raw provider records present / twelve inherited absences**.
+The phase23 basis also retains twelve missing adjacent records. Older phase22's
+31 missing history remains within its sealed packet. Original string/list
+report forms stay unchanged; exact log profiles decide their normalized comparison.
+
+## Retained diagnostic history
+
+The first focused plan had the correct 61-module set in the wrong DFS order and
+was rejected before workspace or compiler creation; only its output lock exists.
+Focused-v2 has exact DFS order, 61 providers / 36 fresh / 25 phase23 reuses. After
+34 fresh successes, its WF universal/existential branches fail to infer subtype
+predicates. Explicit subtype predicates resolve that seam; native-diagnostic-v1
+then fails at raw Sat metavariables. Final typed reflexive equivalences resolve
+that remaining seam. All rejected inputs and raw results remain history; none
+is a failed full-run prefix.
+
+**Native-diagnostic-v2 passes 16 providers / two fresh / fourteen phase23 reuses**
+in **2.74 seconds**, with no warnings in the two fresh final WF modules. Result
+SHA-256 `aef91bd459a9000bb1ace197860b24f8d0f667762a01aec05cfb396351e3751a`.
+It has no typed clients or endpoint audits and establishes no full acceptance.
+The six annotation lines cost 298 bytes and are charged to the final
+**175-line / 8,435-byte** maintained saving. The primary closure remains
+**172 modules / 1,726,277 bytes**; its overlapping 2,210-byte saving is separate.
+
+## Full-run policy and receipts
+
+The reviewed runner uses the fixed accepted phase23 basis, never diagnostic
+objects. The eight runtime assets comprise three wrappers, their pinned adapter
+and configuration, and three exact expanded phase23 base helpers. The
+[runtime layout](../integration/runtime/README.md) names all eight; a captured
+`check.py` alone is not portable. Lean 4.32.0, serial `-j1`, memory `-M12288`,
+`LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1` and the global proof-build lock remain pinned. The selected
+run keeps 120 seconds per ordinary module/audit and 900 seconds for site/source-forward
+batches, with process-group cleanup before lock release. The repository's
+portable driver's existing 900-second default is a separate policy.
+
+[Terminal result](result.json) SHA-256:
+`c9bcee3023ea879ad0dcc353d1435aae8aef92963a4b79f51fda1506f518c910`.
+The outer record reports **1,307.98 seconds**, an observed duration rather than
+a comparative speedup. [Independent actual readback](result-review.json) SHA-256:
+`09a20af33eda29ffcc7779ccad0e3d804063d5413f8afc9e2602e4b51e322687`.
+
+The deterministic [capture](capture.json) contains **640 blobs / 1,078 logical
+entries / 1,071 source aliases / 611 raw evidence files**, with eleven exact
+external phase23 leaves. [Archive](evidence.tar.gz): **1,828,563 bytes**, SHA-256
+`09d3ee5d9a8d7fba84e0ac0ee7c25af034a758c19f16a69d2b554542056b1ed5`.
+[Index](index.json) SHA-256:
+`c8d498dcbc4e3763ab22d86b6e8a72c835387784404030797efc2fb6d4462278`.
+[Configuration](capture-config.json) SHA-256:
+`6728eff177eb270452b08213ceb19181ac72ec2d9b7154a37794edcb62289932`.
+[Capture receipt](capture.json) SHA-256:
+`263f11849690a6dbc6589395e77ff07b38d1a47f69a474553f44462d339fda49`.
+[Independent capture review](../integration/capture-review.json) SHA-256:
+`48e8348b24789b0e0b0bb89a72d7002e9e2f6c95405e7a97ed5b6bff79033192`.
+It checks all 230 current workspace source bindings, 121 fresh attempt triples,
+two audit triples, every member digest and the complete logical/source-alias index.
+
+Four focused diagnostic contexts are preserved as 240 explicitly pinned inert
+files; they are separate from the accepted full run. The capture has no failed
+full-run root. [Integration notes](../integration/README.md) retain the manifest
+preparation rejection and successful successor without calling it a proof failure.
+
+Phase23's eleven exact published Lean evidence leaves remain immutable. The
+archive preserves that external boundary and retained focused preparations
+without fabricating records. Inspect bytes via the index without executing
+archived code; executable proof objects are not publication artifacts. See the [source review](../source-review.md),
+[compatibility notes](../compatibility.md) and [checkpoint](../README.md).
